'''Ral's Run''' was a location in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] was [[Ambush on Ral's Run|ambushed]] while attempting to attack an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy that operated along the run.<ref name="Stay on Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref>
